from.place: proof part (2), pullback compatibility: choose local free generators after pullback and identify the pulled-back coefficient

title: Local coefficient after pulling back a zero-locus morphism
statement: Let $g:Y\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], let $M,N$ be invertible modules on $X$ [def-sc-invertible-module], and let $\varphi:M\to N$. If $U\subseteq X$ is affine with free generators $e_M,e_N$ and $\varphi(e_M)=b\,e_N$, and $V\subseteq Y$ is affine with $V\subseteq g^{-1}(U)$, then the pullback modules have free generators $e'_M,e'_N$ on $V$ and the pulled-back morphism satisfies $((\operatorname{Modules.pullback}\,g).map\,\varphi)(e'_M)=g.appLE\,U\,V\,b\;e'_N$ [def-pc-module-pullback].
